about.title: About Malaysia
about.text: Malaysia, the jewel of Southeast Asia, is a unique study destination that attracts students from all over the world. Malaysia boasts a rich cultural diversity, stunning natural scenery, advanced infrastructure, and a prestigious education system, all at an affordable cost. Malaysia has a rich and diverse culture, home to a mix of ethnic groups such as Malays, Chinese, Indians, and many other nationalities. Malaysia is also a safe and stable country with low crime rates. It also has advanced infrastructure, including an efficient transportation network and high-speed internet services.

items.title: High Educational Quality
items.text: Malaysian universities offer world-class education with advanced teaching and training methods.

items.title: Reasonable Cost
items.text: One of the most important reasons why studying in Malaysia is an excellent choice is that university tuition fees in Malaysia are affordable for students.

items.title: Study in English
items.text: Although the official language of Malaysia is Malay (or Bahasa Melayu), English is also an official language and is widely used in education, daily life, and various transactions.

items.title: Malaysia is an Islamic country
items.text: Malaysia is an Islamic country with a predominantly Muslim population and numerous mosques, which is a significant advantage for Arab students who wish to maintain their identity and avoid cultural alienation.

items.title: Making Diverse Friendships
items.text: Malaysian universities have students from various nationalities and cultures, allowing you to make strong and diverse friendships. Malaysians are also naturally friendly and welcoming to international students.

items.title: Studying in Peace and Security
items.text: Malaysia is a peaceful, safe, and comfortable country, ensuring a calm and reassuring study period for students.

items.title: Diverse Fields of Study
items.text: The Malaysian university education system is characterized by its diversity of fields of study, offering a wide range of disciplines to suit students' interests. These include medicine, engineering, technology, science, arts, economics, business, and more.

items.title: A Temperate Tropical Climate
items.text: Malaysia has an average temperature of 25.4°C. The sun shines throughout the year, except during the tropical rainy season. If you dislike cold weather and enjoy outdoor activities and nature, Malaysia is the perfect destination for your studies.

educationSystem.title: The Education System in Malaysia
educationSystem.text: The Malaysian education system is based on several categories of educational institutions that provide diverse options for students.

costs.title: The Cost of Studying at Malaysian Universities
costs.text: University education in Malaysia is accessible to everyone, especially students seeking high-quality education at reasonable costs.
list: Tuition fees at private universities range from US$3,000 to US$6,000 per year.
Some engineering and medical programs may be more expensive.
The cost of living is low compared to European countries.

housing.title: Types of Student Accommodation in Malaysia
housing.text: Malaysia offers a variety of accommodation options suitable for international students, varying according to budget, location, and lifestyle.

types.title: On-Campus Accommodation
points: A suitable environment for focusing on studies.
Availability of laundry services and recreational spaces.

types.title: Off-Campus Accommodation
types.text: Off-campus accommodation offers students more freedom compared to on-campus housing and is often less expensive when shared with other students. Rents start from RM500 per month.

types.title: Private Housing
types.text: Includes private apartments for students who prefer privacy and independence, and is a suitable option for those with a higher budget.

types.title: Shared Housing
types.text: A popular option among international students to reduce costs, as the apartment is shared with other students of different nationalities.

requirements.title: Admission Requirements for Malaysian Universities
items: Submit letters of recommendation and a statement of purpose.
Submit a high school diploma, a copy of your passport, and a personal photograph.
Some universities may require additional requirements depending on the field of study.

tips.title: Tips Before Traveling to Study in Malaysia

items.title: Explore Malaysia Before You Travel
items.text: Learn about the country's culture, climate, and customs to facilitate adjustment upon arrival.

items.title: Choose Your Major Carefully
items.text: Choose a program that aligns with your passions and future career goals.

items.title: Plan your budget carefully
items.text: Make sure you organize your finances and estimate living costs before traveling.

items.title: Get a student visa
items.text: You need a student permit to study and you can apply through the Malaysian embassy after you receive acceptance.

items.title: Connect with students and graduates
items.text: Connecting with former students gives you a clear idea of ​​life and studying in Malaysia.
